mechanism: Phenobarbital is a potent CYP450 enzyme inducer that increases nafcillin metabolism, potentially reducing nafcillin serum concentrations and antibiotic efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response to nafcillin therapy; consider increasing nafcillin dose or selecting an alternative antibiotic not subject to enzyme induction; monitor phenobarbital levels as nafcillin may competitively inhibit its metabolism.
